Subject: Hosted pricing and model roster — quick ask

Hi Alex,

Quick intro — I’m Samir, Head of Platform at Helix Labs. We’re evaluating hosted inference providers for a consumer-facing feature (multi-turn summarization + light classification). Before we set up a deeper call, can you send your standard per-1M token pricing (split by input vs output if you publish both) for the Hosted API and a short roster of supported models (indicate recommended models for low-latency batch and high-quality chat).

Rough profile: expect ~5M tokens/month initially, spikes during trials. We care about predictable unit economics and whether you offer startup/introductory discounts or committed-month credits. Also curious about any recommended latency tiers and if streaming counts differently for IO.

Thanks — if you can attach a simple ratecard and model list that’d be great.

—Samir

> Quick intro — I’m Samir, Head of Platform at Helix Labs...

Thanks for the note — Samir. Short technical breakdown below to pair with Alex’s commercial details.

Model roster (hosted):
- redwood-chat-xl: Best for multi-turn, high-quality chat (higher output cost, recommended for final responses).
- redwood-instruct-large: Good balance for single-turn summarization and classification.
- redwood-fast-quant (8-bit variant): Lower-cost, lower-latency option for high-volume inference where slight quality tradeoff is acceptable.
- open-compat-bert-like: Efficient embedding/classification model (good for routing decisions).

Published IO rates (per 1M tokens, Hosted API summary):
- input tokens: $0.30 / 1M (all models)
- output tokens: tiered by model: redwood-chat-xl $6.50 / 1M, redwood-instruct-large $2.25 / 1M, redwood-fast-quant $0.95 / 1M

Notes and cost controls:
- Streaming counts as output tokens for billing; we can help minimize tokens by server-side truncation and by pre-filtering length.
- For predictable unit costs, reserved monthly commits are available (discounts scale with commit size).
- Prefix/KV caching can reduce repeated prompt costs for chat scenarios — we can enable session caching which is usually effective for 2–5x savings depending on reuse.

Attached: hosted-model-roster.csv (includes latency medians and recommended sequence-lengths).

Happy to run a quick tokenization/sample on a few representative prompts if you want a concrete cost projection.

-ben

Samir — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a sample quote and a short note on residency. High-level answer first: yes, we can do a limited introductory discount and provide EU-region hosting for tenants on Hosted (we also offer Dedicated for stricter isolation if required).

Sample quote (monthly, 5M tokens, 70% input / 30% output — blended models):
- Input tokens (3.5M @ $0.30 / 1M): $1.05 -> rounded $1.05
- Output tokens (1.5M split: 60% redwood-instruct-large, 40% redwood-chat-xl)
  - redwood-instruct-large (0.9M @ $2.25 / 1M): $2.025
  - redwood-chat-xl (0.6M @ $6.50 / 1M): $3.9
- Subtotal: $6.975 / month -> rounded $6.98

Introductory offer: 20% credit on usage for the first 3 months for qualifying startups (applies to calls on the Hosted API). With the intro credit, effective first-3-months spend would be ~ $5.58 / month on this profile.

Residency: We have EU Hosted regions with tenancy and data-at-rest controls; for regulated workloads we recommend Redwood Dedicated or Private.

Next steps: I’ll share a HubSpot record and a DocuSign PO template if you want to move to a trial commit. If you’d like we can also run a tokenized sample on a set of representative prompts to refine the estimate.
